answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using trust-graph flow routing across a nebula of peers. Interaction histories form verifiable edges that provide structural timber for reputation scores. Bottlenecks around seed nodes force adversaries to commit scarce, authentic social capital per identity rather than multiplying across a shifting dune of clones. However, this creates severe cold-start barriers for new honest agents and fails if attackers infiltrate trusted clusters.
